name: Travel vaccination clinics (category guide)
summary: Yellow fever / Hep A / typhoid before leave — travel clinics vs polyclinic, certificate timing, and why childhood schedules are a different product.
body: Regional weekends and home-leave trips drive last-minute vaccine panic. Dedicated travel clinics stock yellow-fever and less-common vaccines and issue certificates; polyclinics cover many routine adult boosters cheaper for eligible residents, while foreigners often pay private rates either way. Book far enough ahead for multi-dose courses; some destinations want certificates dated within a window. Bring your vaccine record and destination list — ‘Asia package’ shots are not one-size. Corporate outpatient riders may exclude travel medicine entirely. Distinct from childhood vaccination guides for school entry. This is a category guide, not a ranked travel-clinic list.
